column1: jrn_trigger: What was your main reason for wanting to buy sweet snacks?
I had a craving for sweet snacks
I noticed it in store while I was shopping for other things
It was part of my planned grocery shopping
I noticed I had run out
I noticed a promotion on a leaflet from the store
I was asked to buy it by someone in my household
I was writing a shopping list
I was planning to be out all day or travelling
I was planning ahead for when snacks might be needed (e.g. birthday party)
I had visitors coming to my home
I had a recipe that needed certain biscuits
